scope: Pinned upstream source, assertion and complete golden-output contracts for native regression mappings.

groups.title: Aggregate Rust source references
groups.portable_obligation: Inventory of assertions, test helpers and stage boundaries. Each source file groups the individual fixtures and test functions that define its properties.

groups.title: Shared vendor-neutral formula and equivalence engine
groups.portable_obligation: The exact .spec formulas and positive/negative assertions use the same Spec/ExprArena/unfold/equivalence implementation for both backends.

groups.title: Complete output footprint and sampling refusal
groups.portable_obligation: Missing output coordinates and same-count shifted coordinates must never yield ACCEPT; sampled results must remain inconclusive.

groups.title: Complete packed16 8x8 transpose
groups.portable_obligation: Transpose every element j to source[(j%8)*8+j/8], preserving both16-bit elements of every32-bit lane payload.

groups.title: Upstream BF16 matrix layout adapter
groups.portable_obligation: A BF16[16,16] by BF16[16,8] logical M16/N8/K16 product with exact baseline lane0 fragment output projection.

groups.title: Upstream exact high64 magic division
groups.portable_obligation: For u64 a10 and b0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab, take high64(a*b), logical shift right1, narrow to u32, store exact3.

groups.title: Wait-loop exit and phase completion before payload
groups.portable_obligation: A completed barrier phase permits the sole participant to exit its wait and copy in[0] to out[0].

groups.title: Exact dynamic TMEM resource protocol
groups.portable_obligation: No separate portable data output is asserted for these specifically reviewed allocation/free/permit/never-freed diagnostic rows.

groups.title: Exact TCGEN descriptor/shape/quadrant encoding
groups.portable_obligation: Rows specifically assert acceptance/rejection of NVIDIA reserved bits, lane/quadrant encoding, TMEM address restrictions or the TCGEN shape table, without a separate asserted numerical output.

groups.title: Exact cluster cancellation/remote-address contract
groups.portable_obligation: Exact request/decline/cancellation response and nonzero remote-cluster address modes are outside the unclustered native launch envelope; any separately asserted payload remains a portable obligation.

groups.title: Exact PTX-only grammar or proxy scope token
groups.portable_obligation: The exact PTX operation/modifier/scope token is not an AMD instruction; no separate successful data computation is asserted.

groups.title: Named split-barrier participants and generations
groups.portable_obligation: Native signal/wait IDs, arrival accounting, repeated phases, divergence and deadlocks must follow gfx1250 semantics. Portable participant/order obligations cannot inherit gfx950 S_BARRIER exclusions.

groups.title: Barrier object lifetime and completion-domain matching
groups.portable_obligation: Initialization/reinitialization, transaction announcement and phase observation must not lose a real producer/consumer obligation.

groups.title: Exited or inactive participants
groups.portable_obligation: Respect native wave termination, inactive EXEC lanes, defined shuffle sources and remaining-wave barrier progress without treating EXEC masking as per-lane termination.

groups.title: Native copy completion and publication
groups.portable_obligation: Real memory producer effects, register returns and each consumer must complete in the correct native counter domain before reuse/publication. Completion alone is not cross-wave happens-before.

groups.title: Strided2D tensor edge tile and zero fill
groups.portable_obligation: Copy the complete4x4 F16 tile at coordinate(6,6) of8x8 with16-byte row pitch; preserve all in-bounds values and explicit zero fill outside bounds.

groups.title: Descriptor metadata bytes and producer/consumer lifetime
groups.portable_obligation: Read/copy/write every real descriptor byte with correct source/destination overlap, publication and in-flight retention; unrelated metadata waits cannot publish the actual descriptor.

groups.title: Matrix inputs/results and cross-wave publication
groups.portable_obligation: Matrix register operands remain stable through the actual read window; results must be ready before store,store completed before barrier,then read completed by each consumer.

groups.title: Matrix load/store lane/byte layout
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve exact LDS row addresses, halfword packing/transposition and every original output coordinate.

groups.title: Noncontiguous matrix LDS packing
groups.portable_obligation: Use the actual48/64-byte row stride versus a contiguous control; preserve every gathered16-bit element and all256 weighted dot products.

groups.title: Concrete/raw accumulator and immediate identity
groups.portable_obligation: Interpret raw F32 accumulator bits and native materialized immediate C exactly; preserve every original fragment value.

groups.title: TCGEN numeric,shape and dtype payloads
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve complete logical M128/N8/K16 numeric136/raw17 or M128/N8/K32 mixed E4M3/E5M2 numeric408; preserve the full128x256 zero-output shape where asserted.

groups.title: Whole-transfer bounds and native alignment
groups.portable_obligation: Validate the entire scalar/vector/subword transfer against the owning allocation and actual native alignment; reject overflow/wrap and adjacent-object straddles.

groups.title: Subword packing and initialized bytes
groups.portable_obligation: Loads/stores preserve exact bytes/components and cannot turn unknown padding or an absent halfword into defined output.

groups.title: Arguments,globals,dynamic LDS and address spaces
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve configured arrays,bases,kinds,by-value source format,global overrides,static/dynamic LDS placement,grid/workgroup IDs and complete pitched outputs.

groups.title: Exact data race payload and direction
groups.portable_obligation: Equal values do not remove conflicting effects; concrete computed aliasing,actor sets,read/write direction,sparse payloads and correct publication remain observable.

groups.title: Exact encodedF64 constants and real arithmetic
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve exact binary64 constants,raw bit decoding,FMA versus separately rounded literals and full original outputs under the disclosed mathematical-real model.

groups.title: Scalar float identities and source-format decoding
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve exact encoded coefficients,source dtype,sign/min/max/ReLU/transcendental model and every original sparse output.

groups.title: Fixed-width integer arithmetic and bit semantics
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve signed/unsigned widths,wrapping,high products,shifts,funnel/bitfield/clipping,constant interpretation and full outputs.

groups.title: OCP FP8 bytes,packing and format boundaries
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve independent byte lanes,E4M3/E5M2 decoder choice,zero extension,conversion selection,ReLU and NaN refusal.

groups.title: PackedF32 pair and raw data typing
groups.portable_obligation: Preserve two independent F32 components packed in64bits,typed memory/conversion/bit pack/unpack and original pair math.

groups.title: Explicit symbolic/non-real model boundaries
groups.portable_obligation: Unsupported symbolic control/division/type-punning and non-real input/NaN errors must remain explicit; successful concrete versions retain full correct output.

groups.title: Static malformed syntax in all control paths
groups.portable_obligation: Wrong arity/modifiers/tuples/directives/undefined targets reject even behind unreachable branch or zeroEXEC,with legal known native controls.

groups.title: Wave selection,shuffle and reduction
groups.portable_obligation: Respect wave32 active masks,leader election,shuffle-definedness/tail behavior and exact original scalar/vector reduction outputs.

groups.title: Native algebra and exact mismatch coordinates
groups.portable_obligation: Positive reassociation and negative constant/term/index/operation mutations retain exact symbolic results,full output indices,and NotEquivalent mismatches.
